walk_speed_m_per_min.citation: Bohannon RW (1997) Comfortable and maximum walking speed of adults aged 20-79 years: reference values and determinants, Age and Ageing 26(1):15-19 (abstract): mean comfortable gait speed 127.2 cm/s (women in their seventies) to 146.2 cm/s (men in their forties), n = 230 healthy volunteers; maximum 174.9 to 253.3 cm/s.
walk_speed_m_per_min.note: Healthy adults over a 7.62 m walkway, not staff in a hospital corridor; working-age adults sit near 80-88 m/min. Hurrying staff can reach 105-150 m/min (the maximum-speed figures).

fixed_cost_per_hour.note: Averaged over all hours of the year including unstaffed nights; includes OR staff salaries, excludes anaesthesia, recovery, implants. Wave 0 placeholder was 37.5.
